root: ^What did I do to deserve this? The gods have been very unkind to me. I’ve been cursed.
^Divinity is mine! I rule the ocean!
^Enjoy it...whilst it lasts. Why would the gods do this to me?
^Why must they do terrible things to good people...
^I didn’t know that would happen...How could you let me hurt that fish?
^We did what we had to do.
